notablePrerequisites:
Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When the creature enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Repeat.
